findings.passage: As the 88th Legislative Session approaches, I am eager to get to work for my constituents. Throughout my visits and conversations in House District 68, the three biggest concerns are the border, property taxes, and election integrity issues. Texans deserve a secure border, lower property taxes, and have more faith in the election process,
findings.note: Quote from his bill-filing press release as printed by the San Saba News & Star. He names election integrity as one of three top concerns. The text does not mention voter ID or citizenship.

findings.motion: HB 52 filed; referred to House Elections committee 2023-02-23
findings.note: He is the author of HB 52, 'Relating to the penalty for the offense of illegal voting; increasing a criminal penalty.' It stayed in committee. It is about penalties for illegal voting, not ID.
